papers.title_en: LATO.2: Factorized 3D Mesh Generation with Vertex and Topology Flow
papers.authors: Hang Long, Tianhao Zhao, Junkai Lin, Youjia Zhang, Huipeng Guo, Rendong Liang, Jiale Xu, Jozef Hladký, Matthias Nießner, Wei Yang
papers.evidence: 流匹配用于网格生成可应用于CFD网格
papers.tldr: 现有网格生成方法将顶点几何与拓扑结构在联合潜在空间中建模，导致顶点漂移和表面破裂。本文提出LATO.2，一种分解式流匹配框架，将网格生成拆分为顶点流和基于已生成顶点的拓扑流，两者共享粗体素支架。专用VAE分别以亚体素精度恢复顶点，并将离散拓扑嵌入连续空间。该分解支持分部分生成更高分辨率网格，以及拓扑自适应编辑。实验表明，LATO.2在几何保真度和拓扑质量上超越现有方法。
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching over carefully designed latent representations has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for topology-aware mesh generation. Existing approaches, however, model vertices and connectivity jointly in a joint latent space, entangling continuous vertex geometry with discrete combinatorial structure; this complicates flow learning and manifests as drifting vertices and broken surfaces. We present LATO.2, a factorized flow matching framework that decomposes mesh generation into a vertex flow followed by a connectivity flow conditioned on the realized vertices, with both stages anchored to a shared coarse voxel scaffold. Dedicated VAEs underpin the two stages, recovering vertices at sub-voxel precision and embedding discrete connectivity into a continuous latent space. We demonstrate two advantages unique to this factorization: (i) part-wise generation, in which the scaffold is partitioned and each part synthesized at full latent capacity, yielding substantially higher-resolution meshes than a monolithic latent permits; and (ii) topology-adaptive editing, in which manipulating first-stage vertices induces the corresponding connectivity without re-optimization. Experiments show that LATO.2 surpasses state-of-the-art topology-aware mesh generators in geometric fidelity and connectivity quality.
